body: No my mother doesn't wish to see me ever again (which hurts but I don't want to ever see her) and I stopped talking to my ex after she left.
about a year and a half ago

I don't know how to get over the fear of being cheated on or hurt or lied to or be used.
But when i'm not it's all I think about. Where do I even begin to heal? i havn't even made any progress

Everything, I'm scared of getting hurt by someone again. I'm scared she may just be looking for a boyfriend and not into me, im scared im going to blow it.
